conventions.terminal: a component position, entered by a move, in which some side has a passed pawn (textbook passed test: e.p. NOT respected, as in the runs). The convention scores it an immediate win for the passer's side; races (both passed) by RACE_RULE (default 'count').
conventions.results: terminals: White's view, white_result_white_first / white_result_black_first. Node positions: result for the side to move, plus 'white_result'.
conventions.class: L = White wins whoever moves first; R = Black wins whoever moves first; N = side to move wins; P = side to move loses; D = a draw for at least one side.
conventions.frozen_king_wrong: true iff the real result differs from the convention (RACE_RULE 'count'). It flags EVERY convention failure (frozen kings, e.p., races, counter-passers); see 'diagnosis_inferred' / 'traces_to_derived' and DATA.md for attribution.
conventions.rule_based_diagnosis:
Rule-based diagnosis (inference) of a terminal whose real result for `side_key` contradicts the convention.
    Rules, in order: (1) e.p. right owned by the side to move and an e.p. capture among its best recorded moves
    (or no record) -> en passant; (2) a king move strictly beats every recorded pawn move -> king leaves the
    trebuchet; (3) best recorded moves are pawn captures -> counter-passer (capture); pawn pushes -> race (if a
    race terminal) or counter-passer (push); (4) no record: race terminal -> race; side to move has a component
    capture -> counter-passer (probable); else unclear.
conventions.derived_offline: fields ending in _derived_offline are re-derived offline from realchess.component / cylcgt (4-file flat board, e.p. on, textbook passed test), not read from result files.
